articles.headline: Absolute Security acquires Phoenix Technologies’ FirmGuard to expand firmware security
articles.summary: The acquisition extends security coverage deeper into UEFI BIOS firmware, an area that can be difficult for businesses to monitor but critical for device integrity. This matters for organizations managing fleets of laptops and endpoints because firmware-level attacks can bypass conventional defenses and raise recovery costs.

articles.headline: AI revenue questions pull semiconductor stocks off October highs
articles.summary: Reports that OpenAI’s annualized revenue was below prior expectations weakened sentiment across chip stocks, showing how AI spending assumptions can move semiconductor valuations. The piece matters for businesses because it signals that AI infrastructure demand, and the related supply chain for chips and cloud capacity, may be more volatile than investors expected.

articles.headline: Samsung, SK Hynix record earnings fuel South Korea spending on AI
articles.summary: Coverage of record earnings from Samsung and SK Hynix points to continued AI-driven memory demand, which is important for companies buying servers, devices, and AI infrastructure. The business impact is that memory pricing, availability, and procurement planning may remain tight as AI spending continues to reshape the supply chain.
